newsitem.title: UK: Railtrack shares fall, SocGen bearish.
newsitem.headline: Railtrack shares fall, SocGen bearish.

text.p: Shares in Railtrack Plc fell on Friday after analysts at SocGen restated a "strong sell" recommendation on the stock, dealers said.
By 1024 GMT, Railtack shares were down three pence at 410-1/2 on volume of 1.3 million.

SocGen analyst Marshall Whiting said Thursday's comments by Railtrack regulator John Swift were a concern for the company, in particular Swift's assertion that Railtrack's "current level of underspend is totally unacceptable".
"It was very significant that he used such strong language," Whiting said. "Had that sort of language come from a water regulator or electricity regulator the price would have come off 10 percent."

Railtrack shares are currently partly-paid and further payment is due from shareholders in June. "There's a two pounds call due in June, by which time there could be a change of government, and people are sitting on profits. So it could be time to take profits," Whiting said.
